   ```bash
   source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate
   cd /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie
   # 检查 tmux sessions 是否还在
   tmux list-sessions 2>/dev/null | grep exp027

   ```bash
   cd /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/output/exp_027_fewnerd_n16
   # 找到输出文件名（可能是 sampled_results.jsonl 或 samples.jsonl）

   ```

   ```bash

   ```bash
   python code/analyze_fewnerd_results.py --help
   # 或查看 exp-021 怎么跑的
   head -5 output/exp_021_inference/results.json
   ```

   import json, numpy as np

   # - LP = logprob of each sample
   # - LP selection = sample with max logprob → its F1
   # - Oracle = sample with max F1
   # - Degeneracy = all samples have same key_set
   ```
   
   参考 exp-021 的分析代码结构。

   ```python

   ```

   Headroom (pp)   | 13.8          | ???            |
   LP ρ            | 0.42          | ???            |

   ```

- F1 计算: 使用与 exp-021 一致的方法（entity-level micro F1）
